name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited

facts.business: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited is a credit card issuer and payment services provider in India, offering a range of consumer and corporate credit cards, co-branded cards, and digital payment solutions.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on (a) additional impairment provision of Rs 220 crores as management overlay over ECL model as of March 31, 2026; (b) reversal of GST liability of Rs 76.57 crores (including Rs 54.41 crores for FY 2024-25) on late payment fees billed but not collected.

key_risks: Credit risk and impairment loss allowance based on expected credit loss (ECL) model
Regulatory and compliance risks across SEBI, RBI, MCA, DIPAM, TRAI, CERT-In, MeitY, NPCI
Taxation risks including GST on late payment fees
Operational risks related to loan restructuring and provisioning
